name: Philadelphia Youth Commission
org: Mayor's Office of Youth Engagement, City of Philadelphia
what_you_do: Advise the Mayor, City Council and schools on issues that affect young people. Review laws. Run youth-led events and public service programs. You work in committees on education, public safety, health and recreation, and jobs and money.
who_can_apply: The 2021 city announcement said Philadelphia residents ages 12 to 24. The current page does not repeat the age rule, so confirm it.
deadline_text: No application dates on the current page. The 2021 announcement said applications were reviewed on a rolling basis.
how_to_apply: Current page links a standing committee interest form (Formstack). Phone for the office: (215) 685-8307.
notes: City-wide teen council. The committee form on the current page is an interest form, not confirmed to be the membership application. Ask the office how members are chosen now.
